positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Serve as lead or sole developer on multiple full stack web applications using Ruby on Rails, Javascript,
Typescript, HTML/CSS, React/Redux, Docker, and MS SQL Server.
- Manage development projects with multiple junior developers using agile methodology, Jira, and Gitlab.
- Plan and lead efforts to refactor code base, improve readability, and reduce redundancy. Reduced production errors by over 50% over six month period.
- Lead projects to optimize database queries across a suite of apps, using SQL, Ruby on Rails, and the Bullet Gem. Cut load times over 80% on average across over 50 pages.
- Lead campus recruiting efforts, including job postings, interviews, and onboarding of new hires.

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a suite of web applications using React, Java, Spring, and PostgreSQL.
- Developed a web UI and data pipeline for time series simulations using React-Bootstrap and Spring Boot.
- Built data pipelines for near real-time analysis using Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana.
- Led development of client websites using PHP and CakePHP, communicating directly with clients.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built full stack web applications using Ruby on Rails, Javascript, HTML/CSS, and React/Redux.
- Managed and extended test suites using Rspec, Jest, and Enzyme.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed embedded systems for autonomous vehicle navigation in GPS denied environments
- Implemented computer vision algorithms for robot localization and 3D mapping using ROS, Python, C++, and OpenCV
- Developed change detection and tracking algorithms for aerial imagery in Matlab

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed user interface controls with the Oculus Rift, allowing users to virtually interact with and test a Kuka robotics manufacturing arm. Used Python, C++, ROS and OpenCV libraries.

company.name: Johns Hopkins Computational Interaction and Robotics Laboratory

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed machine learning algorithms for classification of product sales data using R and Python.
- Improved big data cleaning speeds using Clojure and Apache Spark.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Constructed a live graphical display of company change data using Tableau and SQL
- Automated employee data organization and visualization using Visual Basic and Tableau

educations.fieldOfStudy: Applied Mathematics and Statistics, Economics, Minor Computer Science

honors.description: Granted to students with a minimum average AP exam score of 3.5, and at least 5 test scores of a 4 or above.

honors.description: Granted to students with a semester GPA of 3.5 or higher.
